jobs.title: Software Engineer Task Author (AI Training)
jobs.description:
About The Role

Alignerr is building a dataset of expert tasks that train and evaluate advanced AI agents on real enterprise engineering work. As a Task Author based in Bangalore, you will design and calibrate authentic engineering challenges — diagnosing failing integrations from logs, tracing bugs through codebases, and writing and verifying real fixes — that genuinely push the limits of capable AI agents.

Bangalore's engineering talent is world-class, and this role is designed for working engineers with real industry experience in backend systems, SaaS infrastructure, APIs, or enterprise software. This is not a generalist or instructional role — it requires hands-on engineering skill.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: Flexible, task-based

Key Responsibilities

Author realistic engineering task prompts covering integration failures, log-based debugging, bug traces through source code, and configuration or integration fixes
Write scoring rubrics that define exactly what a correct fix or diagnosis looks like and how it is verified — including live environment validation where applicable
Set up task environments with realistic codebases, logs, alerts, and system states that place an AI agent in a plausible engineering situation
Solve each task yourself — write the actual fix and confirm it works — to validate the task is sound and the rubric is accurate
Calibrate task difficulty by adjusting code complexity, log volume, failure modes, or ambiguity until the task reliably challenges the model to the intended degree
Review and correct AI-drafted task prompts or rubrics when provided

Qualifications

Working software engineer with hands-on, industry-level experience — this is not a theoretical or instructional role
Fluency in Git, version control workflows, and code review practices
Strong debugging skills: comfortable reading logs, using observability tools, and tracing failures through a codebase
Experience with infrastructure, integrations, and configuration code (APIs, services, config files, CI/CD)
Ability to write and verify a code fix in a live or simulated environment
Ability to define precise, checkable correctness criteria for engineering outcomes
Strong written communication skills in English

Nice to Have

Experience in enterprise SaaS, fintech, or industrial IoT engineering contexts common in Bangalore's tech ecosystem
Background with monitoring and observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, or PagerDuty
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, well-defined task-based work
Contribute directly to how AI systems understand and perform real software engineering
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer (AI Data Trainer)

About The Role

What if your technical expertise could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems reason, plan, and solve problems? We're looking for Machine Learning Engineers to work on a high-impact project at the frontier of AI development — creating the structured reasoning data that teaches large language models to think more reliably in the real world.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for technical minds who can think clearly, write precisely, and break complex problems into logical, explainable steps.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Author clear, structured reasoning traces that capture how an expert approaches and solves complex technical tasks
Document step-by-step planning, decision-making, and tool use in a way that AI models can learn from
Create high-quality training data that demonstrates sound logic, effective problem decomposition, and reliable real-world reasoning
Evaluate and refine AI decision-making workflows to improve model behavior
Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

Background in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field
Able to articulate complex logical steps and technical reasoning clearly in writing
Strong analytical thinker with a systematic, methodical approach to problem-solving
Detail-oriented and consistent — you take pride in the quality and precision of your work
Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision

Nice to Have

Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or AI evaluation systems
Familiarity with LLM behavior, prompt engineering, or AI training workflows
Background in software engineering, applied ML, or research
Experience documenting technical processes or writing structured technical content

Why Join Us

Work directly with leading AI research labs on genuinely cutting-edge projects
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work
Gain rare, hands-on insight into how advanced LLMs are trained and improved
Contribute to AI development that shapes how models reason across the real world
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

CrowdStrike is a global leader in cybersecurity dedicated to protecting organizations by leveraging advanced technology and innovative solutions. Since its founding in 2011, CrowdStrike has established itself as a pioneer in the cybersecurity industry, utilizing an AI-native platform to prevent breaches and defend against sophisticated threats. The company's infrastructure processes nearly 3 trillion events daily, supporting a diverse client base across various industries worldwide. CrowdStrike's mission-driven approach emphasizes responsible AI adoption, continuous experimentation, and innovation, fostering a culture that values autonomy, flexibility, and relentless customer focus. Recognized as a market and technology leader, CrowdStrike offers its employees a dynamic environment where they can grow their careers while contributing to a safer digital world.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Engineer to join our Falcon Risk Platform team at CrowdStrike. In this critical role, you will be instrumental in designing and building the foundational risk platform that underpins our industry-leading cybersecurity solutions. You will work with cutting-edge technologies such as Golang, microservices architecture, and diverse database ecosystems to deliver comprehensive visibility into organizational risks, management features, and prioritization workflows. Your work will contribute to a globally distributed, fault-tolerant, and highly scalable cloud ecosystem that integrates risk data from CrowdStrike’s internal providers and third-party sources. As a technical leader, you will drive end-to-end product delivery, architect scalable solutions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to define priorities and scope. This role offers an exciting opportunity to influence the cybersecurity landscape by developing innovative exposure management solutions that safeguard organizations from complex threats. If you are passionate about operating at scale and eager to learn Golang, we welcome your application.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess over 10 years of experience in building, delivering, and maintaining large-scale distributed systems processing high-volume data. Strong expertise in object-oriented programming languages such as Golang or Python is essential, along with proven experience in designing scalable microservices and REST APIs. Candidates should have a solid background in developing data platforms involving distributed ETLs and data ingestion pipelines, along with comprehensive knowledge of cloud infrastructure providers like AWS, Azure, or GCP. A deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including concurrency and scalability patterns, is required. Proficiency with message queues such as Kafka, and database versatility across RDBMS, NoSQL, and distributed caches like Redis, is necessary. Candidates should demonstrate excellent troubleshooting skills for complex architectures, adherence to engineering best practices, and the ability to mentor junior engineers. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent professional background is expected. Bonus qualifications include experience with machine learning, AI technologies, cybersecurity, graph databases, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and open-source contributions.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Engineer at CrowdStrike, your responsibilities will include designing and developing scalable backend services that power both internal and customer-facing applications, ensuring high performance, security, and reliability. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and develop APIs, microservices, and data pipelines that support platform growth. Working closely with the DevOps team, you will design and implement cloud infrastructure solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP, automating deployment and monitoring processes while ensuring compliance with security standards. You will design and optimize database solutions, including RDBMS, NoSQL, and distributed data stores, to support data integrity and performance. Troubleshooting complex distributed architectures to resolve performance bottlenecks and reliability issues will be a key aspect of your role, along with developing monitoring and logging solutions to enhance system visibility. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Additionally, you will lead operational excellence initiatives, including configuring monitoring, alerting, incident response, and ensuring high availability of production services. Your work will directly impact the security posture of our clients by enabling robust risk management and exposure analysis capabilities.

Benefits

CrowdStrike offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. Benefits include competitive compensation and equity awards, physical and mental wellness programs, and generous paid time off, including holidays and vacation days. The company provides paid parental and adoption leave to support work-life balance. Employees have access to ongoing professional development opportunities, fostering continuous learning and career advancement. CrowdStrike promotes a vibrant workplace culture with employee networks, community groups, and volunteer opportunities that encourage connection and engagement. The company’s offices feature world-class amenities, creating an inspiring environment for collaboration. Recognized as a Great Place to Work™, CrowdStrike is committed to creating an inclusive, supportive, and innovative workplace where employees can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the company's mission.

Equal Opportunity

CrowdStrike is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our innovation and effectiveness, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action programs and are committed to creating a culture of belonging where everyone is valued and empowered to succeed. If you require assistance accessing our website or submitting an application, please contact us at recruiting@crowdstrike.com for support.
